Since this is headed to our public repository for external developers, I'll need the full legal gate checklist completed before I can record final approval on the release ticket. Can I get status updates from open-source, commercial, export-control, and privacy counsel on where we stand with the Atlas toolkit review?

transcript.text: I need to flag a commercial issue. I have not yet added this contract restriction to the release checklist.
